conditions.name: Discoid Lupus Erythematosus

ratingSchedule.note: DC 7809, discoid lupus erythematosus; evaluate under the General Rating Formula for the Skin.

reviewNotes: Keep this cutaneous identity distinct from the existing systemic-lupus-erythematosus catalog entry. The rating schedule expressly cautions against combining DC 7809 with DC 6350 for the same manifestations.
